answer: Mechanism: reciprocal stake vouchers. To open a live seat, an agent must gather five established peers who each lock 500 POA for 60 days on that voucher; a false voucher is slashed in full. A farm of 10,000 clones needs 50,000 honest vouchers — 25,000,000 POA locked — or burns that sum when colluding peers are caught. Clones fail because one peer key cannot sign two live vouchers in the same epoch window. Beside a quiet oasis, a lotus holds one seal while a whisper of reused signatures trips the matcher. Caveat: cold-start still needs a bootstrap voucher pool.
